# Sidequest Pass 816: os means “dazu”

The sole `os` occurs in f10r H1-S001 between:

- `cthy = T+Y`: apply the current item;
- `chair = CH+AIR`: take water.

The old dictionary value FACH had no visible compartment and disappeared from
the fluent sentence. ORT duplicates the picture owner; WERKZEUG invents an
unseen tool; TRENNSCHRITT is a meta-instruction; a copied source label has no
second occurrence.

The one-word connector that repairs the sentence is:

> `os = DAZU`

The passage now reads:

> Den laufenden Posten kurz entnehmen; den Ansatz im Vorgang bereiten und aus
> der Quelle anwenden; **dazu Wasser entnehmen**; danach den Posten
> weiterführen, nach Sollmaß ansetzen und kurz anwenden.

`os` remains a learned whole form rather than a productive component, but it is
now a meaningful connector instead of a silently omitted placeholder.

# Sidequest Pass 819: sixth compact workshop grammar

The sixth edition integrates the three last whole-card revisions into the full
fixed-page prose inventory:

- `os = DAZU`;
- `dchol/schol = DAVON`;
- `talam = BEISEITESTELLEN`.

All 173 exact cards, 381 events, and 116 workshop statements rebuild. The
productive core remains 33 components. It touches 170 cards / 377 events and
fully composes 167 cards / 374 events.

The six remaining non-core cards are no longer semantic blanks. Three contain
strictly bound pieces: AN=NACHGABE, DA=ZWEI before IIN, and LD=BEFESTIGEN before
DY. Three are learned short whole words: DAZU, DAVON, and BEISEITESTELLEN. They
cover seven events together. Nothing in this exception inventory is UNKNOWN.

# Sidequest Pass 824: weiter, danach, dazu

All 75 order-word memberships retain a three-way distinction:

- `OL = WEITER` continues the same operation or relation (48 events);
- `OT = DANACH` advances to the next operation or item (26 events);
- `OS = DAZU` adds linked material or a clause without forcing temporal order
  (1 event).

The singleton OS is weak by frequency but strong inside its one sentence. In
f10r H1-S001, OS connects work on the current item to taking water. Two events
later the writer uses an OT-bearing card for the actual next-step transition.
Reading both as DANACH would erase a contrast made locally by the same scribe.

DABEI would claim simultaneity; MIT needs a noun-argument construction; ABER
needs a contrast. DAZU is the shortest useful reading and remains a memorized
whole connector.

No order value changes in this pass.
